novelty_method: Immediate-neighbor semantic review of Lyren's twenty frozen proposals and successor recommendation bank, with the inherited 3610-row commitment treated as immutable. The phase does not scan unchanged history and awards no novelty or completion credit to selected inherited rows.
selection_credit: The twenty Lyren contracts are selected for literal preservation and earn zero Ilyra novelty or automatic completion credit.

selected_inherited.description: Preserve reserved-device component refusal without claiming complete Windows compatibility.
Preserve trailing-dot and trailing-space refusal.
Preserve bounded confusable review as non-exhaustive.
Preserve archive traversal and separator parity refusal.
Preserve CBOR obligations as representation rather than conformance.
Preserve DSSE envelope structure without signature validity.
Preserve in-toto statement shape without provenance truth.
Preserve explicit clock-source declarations.
Preserve locale-independent ordering without cultural-collation claims.
Preserve timestamp-independent semantic commitments.
Preserve executable-bit allowlist refusal.
Preserve strict UTF-8 refusal without transcoding.
Preserve external signing and trust policy as exact gates.
Preserve affected-user accessibility evaluation reservations.
Preserve independent reproduction as an absent external gap.
Preserve closed digest-algorithm refusal.
Preserve duplicate normalized archive-member refusal.
Preserve length-prefixed Merkle-leaf framing.
Preserve GMUT dimensions and sign-convention boundaries.
Preserve contradiction-visible THOS, Freed ID, and CBR handover boundaries.

new_proposals.title: Declared decompression-budget refusal
new_proposals.hypothesis: Synthetic archive metadata can be checked against exact compressed-byte, expanded-byte, and ratio ceilings before any decoder or extraction surface is invoked.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A zero compressed size, negative size, expanded size over budget, or ratio over budget passes; or the check is described as real decompression assurance.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Every preregistered over-budget metadata tuple fails and one bounded tuple passes without allocating expanded bytes.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Refuse the member, retain the metadata, and invoke no decoder.

new_proposals.title: Sparse logical-versus-stored size receipt
new_proposals.hypothesis: A typed synthetic record can distinguish nonnegative logical size from stored size and reject stored size greater than logical size without materializing a sparse file.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Negative sizes or stored size greater than logical size pass, or the receipt is called a filesystem measurement.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Valid synthetic sizes preserve both fields and invalid relationships fail without file creation.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the record and retain the contradictory size tuple.

new_proposals.title: Archive link-metadata refusal
new_proposals.hypothesis: A closed synthetic entry-kind policy can refuse hardlink and symlink metadata before path resolution or extraction.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A link-shaped entry passes, an ordinary file is rejected, or a target path is resolved.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only declared regular-file and directory kinds pass; link kinds fail before target evaluation.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the member and perform no extraction or target traversal.

new_proposals.title: UNC and extended Windows path refusal
new_proposals.hypothesis: A lexical classifier can reject UNC, device, and extended-length Windows prefixes before ordinary archive-member normalization.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A double-separator root, device prefix, or extended prefix passes, or a bounded relative path is rejected.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: All preregistered absolute prefixes fail and a relative nested path passes.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Refuse the reference before filesystem access and retain the exact lexical form.

new_proposals.title: URI member-reference percent-normalization
new_proposals.hypothesis: A non-dereferencing normalizer can uppercase percent triplets, decode only unreserved octets, and reject malformed or traversal-bearing member references.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Malformed percent syntax, double decoding, an encoded parent segment, an authority, or a scheme passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Equivalent unreserved encodings normalize once, reserved octets remain encoded, and unsafe forms fail without dereference.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the raw reference and refuse resolution.

new_proposals.title: JSON number lexical-boundary contract
new_proposals.hypothesis: A strict JSON-number lexer with declared length and exponent bounds can reject leading plus, leading zero, malformed exponent, and overlong forms before numeric conversion.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A non-JSON numeric spelling or over-budget lexeme passes, or arbitrary-precision correctness is claimed.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: The bounded valid corpus passes exactly and every preregistered malformed or over-budget lexeme fails before float conversion.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Refuse the numeric token and retain its exact text.

new_proposals.title: Nonfinite and negative-zero schema refusal
new_proposals.hypothesis: A schema-specific numeric guard can reject NaN, infinities, and negative zero while accepting ordinary finite values.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A nonfinite or sign-bit negative zero value passes, or the local refusal is described as universal JSON behavior.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: All preregistered nonfinite and negative-zero values fail; ordinary finite controls pass.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Refuse the field and require an explicitly reviewed schema change.

new_proposals.title: Content-type allowlist and quarantine
new_proposals.hypothesis: A closed lowercase media-type allowlist can classify unknown, parameterized, empty, or option-like values as quarantined without executing content.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: An undeclared type passes, content is opened, or registry presence is treated as safety.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only exact declared types pass and all unknown forms fail without parsing their payloads.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the payload and require additive allowlist review.

new_proposals.title: Attestation subject-digest agreement
new_proposals.hypothesis: A bounded synthetic validator can require each in-toto-shaped subject digest to use the declared algorithm and exact digest width.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: An algorithm mismatch, missing digest, wrong width, or nonhex value passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Matching synthetic digests pass and every preregistered disagreement fails with provenance_verified false.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the statement and issue zero provenance credit.

new_proposals.title: DSSE pre-authentication encoding vectors
new_proposals.hypothesis: A byte-exact DSSE PAE helper can length-prefix an ASCII payload type and arbitrary payload without signing or verification.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Non-ASCII payload types, ambiguous lengths, or altered payloads produce an accepted equivalent vector.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: The preregistered vectors match exact bytes, mutations differ, and no signature operation occurs.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Withdraw the helper and keep signature verification false if framing differs.

new_proposals.title: in-toto predicate-version reservation
new_proposals.hypothesis: A closed predicate-type registry can refuse unreviewed schema versions while keeping provenance truth false.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: An unknown predicate type passes or allowlisting is described as provenance verification.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only the exact synthetic reviewed predicate URI passes and every other version fails.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the unknown predicate and require explicit schema review.

new_proposals.title: Clock rollback and monotonic-duration separation
new_proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic receipt can flag wall-clock rollback while retaining a nonnegative monotonic duration as the only elapsed-time field.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Wall-clock reversal becomes negative elapsed time, a negative monotonic value passes, or the result is called trusted time.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Rollback is explicitly flagged and monotonic duration remains separate and nonnegative.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject negative duration and require a fresh separately labeled observation.

new_proposals.title: RFC 3339 offset normalization
new_proposals.hypothesis: A bounded parser can require an explicit offset and normalize equivalent instants to UTC without claiming civil-time or timezone authority.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: An offset-free timestamp passes, an invalid form is coerced, or local-zone meaning is inferred.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Equivalent offset forms yield the same UTC instant and naive timestamps fail.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the source timestamp and refuse normalization.

new_proposals.title: Duplicate JSON Pointer target refusal
new_proposals.hypothesis: Canonical token escaping can detect two derived evidence-map entries that resolve to the same JSON Pointer target.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Invalid escape syntax, duplicate canonical targets, or a nonabsolute pointer passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Distinct valid pointers pass and every duplicate or malformed target fails with both labels retained.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the derived map and preserve the conflicting inputs.

new_proposals.title: GMUT causal-support and boundary-condition board
new_proposals.hypothesis: A typed symbolic board can represent support, causal order, boundary conditions, units, approximation domain, provenance, and falsifiers for a candidate effective-field term.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A missing typing obligation is hidden or the board is promoted to a detected force, prediction, likelihood, constraint, physical proof, or Theory of Everything.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: The board preserves every declared typing field and explicitly refuses empirical promotion.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain any mismatch and keep the artifact represented only.

new_proposals.title: THOS museum-object condition and custody handover
new_proposals.hypothesis: Synthetic traces can represent object identity, condition revision, treatment hold, custody state, correction readback, workload ceiling, escalation, and shift acceptance.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A fictional trace is promoted to real conservation competence, custody, safety, treatment, employment, or operational effectiveness.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: All corrections and holds remain visible and zero real object, person, institution, treatment, or result is represented.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Remove operational language and retain only the bounded synthetic state trace.

new_proposals.title: Freed ID evidence-receipt minimization profile
new_proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic profile can make digest agreement, predicate version, media type, disclosure minimization, linkability risk, status, recovery, and verifier policy explicit.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Synthetic fields are promoted to a real identity, key, signature, credential, privacy review, interoperability result, or trust decision.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Every real key, identity, signature, network, privacy, recovery, and governance surface remains absent and explicit.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Remove any real-world claim and retain the profile as representation only.

new_proposals.title: Accessible condition-report alternative-format structure
new_proposals.hypothesis: A static report can structurally expose captions, scoped headers, status text, revision sequence, noncolour cues, print fallback, and a plain-text alternative.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Structural checks are promoted to manual keyboard, browser, assistive-technology, cognitive, Maori-language, or affected-user completion.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: The structural regions exist and every manual, language, cultural, and affected-user evaluation remains unexecuted.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Remove completion wording and preserve the evaluation gaps.

new_proposals.title: GWTC-5.0 zero-row GMUT adapter
new_proposals.hypothesis: A source-linked zero-row contract can name the official GWTC-5.0 catalog, event selection, strain, data quality, calibration, posterior, checksum, and likelihood obligations while refusing all empirical output.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Any real row is downloaded or ingested, any likelihood or posterior is evaluated, or public availability is called empirical GMUT evidence.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Remain open_gap with zero queries, downloads, rows, events, likelihoods, posteriors, constraints, or empirical GMUT claims.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Stop before network retrieval and preserve the missing empirical work.

new_proposals.title: Museum access, treatment, return, remedy, and authority matrix
new_proposals.hypothesis: A reservation matrix can make access, treatment, movement, custody, return, repatriation, privacy, remedy, legal, cultural, affected-party, data-governance, and Maori-authority questions visible without deciding them.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Repository software makes or implies a real access, treatment, return, repatriation, remedy, legal, cultural, governance, or Maori-authority decision.
primary_source_needs: tangata whenua, iwi, hapu, and Maori authorities
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Remain exact_gate; every real decision and legitimacy claim stays with competent authorities and affected people.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Stop before any real record, object, treatment, remedy, or authority action.

boundary: This immutable x1 freeze is planning evidence only. It does not implement x2, close any gate, validate a final commit, deliver a baton, or authorize Stage 20.
